description_excerpt: Job Description We are looking for a Senior Front-End Developer specializing in UX Engineering to help shape the next generation of global enterprise workflow platforms used by 500,000+ users worldwide. This role sits at the intersection of UX design and software engineering — transforming complex enterprise workflows, automation systems, and data-heavy applications into intuitive, scalable, and high-performance user experiences. You will collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Backend Engineers to deliver modern, accessible, and globally scalable enterprise…
benefits: Work on global enterprise platforms used by hundreds of thousands of users worldwide
Shape user experiences for complex enterprise and workflow systems
Collaborate with global Product, UX, and Engineering teams
Work with modern front-end technologies and scalable design systems
Opportunity to influence UX standards, engineering quality, and product experience at scale
